note: Capabilities that the browser client executes locally. The core plans them and reports them honestly; the client runs them and reports the outcome back through POST /v1/actions/{id}/complete.

capabilities.label: play a movie
capabilities.detail: Plays the bundled open-licensed film with the real subtitle timing, and the movie companion reacts to what is actually said.

capabilities.label: play music
capabilities.detail: Plays music in the client and keeps the playback controls in sync with the voice conversation.

capabilities.label: play a game
capabilities.detail: Starts one of the local games, for example chess.
